title: EvalRun
description: HAR-145: the eval run of one agent run: the persisted EvalResults (eval_runs rows) of that run's candidates, counted. An EvalRun is not a separate stored object: its id is the agent run id, so every EvalResult already belongs to exactly one. Counts are real tallies of persisted EvalResults, never a percentage or a score: pass, warn, fail and unknown (an `abstain` verdict: the evaluator ran and could not judge). An eval judged not relevant has no EvalResult and is not counted here. `previous_eval_run_id` is the account's previous episode's EvalRun by run creation time (null for its first). It is the previous EPISODE of the account (an earlier run, normally for a different event), not a re-run of the same trigger, so a delta mixes a new event with any change in the system and does not say what a change did. GET /eval-runs/compare is the before/after of one trigger.  every delta is this run's count minus that run's, or null when there is no previous run. The area roll-up uses contracts/evals/eval_areas.json. Operational metrics (tokens, latency, cost) are not evals and are not here.

evaluated_at.description: created_at of the run's newest EvalResult: the replay clock when the run is a replay, so it orders results within an account but is not the write time.

result_count.description: Equals counts.total; kept so a consumer can show 'n results' without reading counts.

areas.description: The four areas in display order, always all four; an area with no results has measured false and zero counts (it is not measured, not healthy).

blocking_fail.description: Of the fails, those that block the send (EvalResult.blocking).

countsDelta.description: this - previous for every count; a negative number is a decrease.

measured.description: True when at least one EvalResult of the area exists in this run.
